name: SAR 7/24 Platinum
lead: Sarsılmaz's newest pistol series SAR 7/24, a product of advanced engineering, is the choice of those who want to feel safe at any time and under any circumstances with its clear, decisive, and professional design approach.
description: Sarsılmaz's newest pistol series SAR 7/24, a product of advanced engineering, is the choice of those who want to feel safe at any time and under any circumstances with its clear, decisive, and professional design approach.

The flat trigger design with a single-action trigger system and adjustable reset distance distinguish SAR 7/24 from its competitors with the advantages of faster first shots, practical use, and safe transportation. The body design specially developed for the SAR 7/24 is complemented by body lines that maximize ergonomic grip both during gripping and shooting. Another distinctive feature of the SAR 7/24 is the vertical trigger guard that facilitates ergonomic grip. The SAR 7/24, fed with a double-row 17-round capacity magazine, has a barrel bushing mounted on the cover assembly, which improves the feel of the barrier shot and provides an advantage in rapid firing. SAR 7/24 also offers the user the highest level of shooting performance with its ergonomic structure that takes into account the weight balance factor suitable for the “full size” class.
